line:
A child does not need a conversation performed. A child needs a person who can be found. Being findable is the practice. The words can come later, or not.

This is the work of a marriage. ugebhezi, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 亰 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Be findable. Tell the house which room you will be in, and be in it.

line:
Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

This is the work of a marriage. ugebhezi, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 亳 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work of a marriage. ugebhezi, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 亶 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work of a marriage. umgogodla, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 亹 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work of a marriage. umgogodla, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 亻 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work of a marriage. umgogodla, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 亼 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work of a marriage. umgogodla, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 什 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of a marriage. isandla, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 仁 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of a marriage. isandla, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 仂 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of a marriage. isandla, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 仃 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of a marriage. isandla, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仄 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of a marriage. unyawo, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 仆 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of a marriage. unyawo, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 仇 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of a marriage. unyawo, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仈 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of a marriage. unyawo, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 今 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of a marriage. idolo, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 介 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of a marriage. idolo, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仍 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of a marriage. idolo, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 从 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of a marriage. idolo, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 仐 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of a marriage. ihlombe, indololwane, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仔 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of a marriage. ihlombe, indololwane, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仕 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of a marriage. ihlombe, indololwane, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 他 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of a marriage. ihlombe, indololwane, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 仗 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of a marriage. inhliziyo, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 付 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of a marriage. inhliziyo, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 仙 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of a marriage. inhliziyo, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 仚 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of a marriage. inhliziyo, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 仝 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of a marriage. imithambo, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 仞 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of a marriage. imithambo, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 仟 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of a marriage. imithambo, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 仡 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of a marriage. imithambo, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 代 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. ubuchopho, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 令 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of a marriage. ubuchopho, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 仫 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of a marriage. ubuchopho, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仭 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of a marriage. ubuchopho, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仮 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. amaphaphu, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 仰 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of a marriage. amaphaphu, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仱 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of a marriage. amaphaphu, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 仲 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of a marriage. amaphaphu, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 仵 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of a marriage. izitho zokugaya ukudla, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 件 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of a marriage. izitho zokugaya ukudla, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 价 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of a marriage. izitho zokugaya ukudla, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 任 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of a marriage. izitho zokugaya ukudla, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 仼 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of a marriage. inso, i-nephron, maphakathi is the place this turning becomes visible. 份 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of a marriage. inso, i-nephron, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 仿 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of a marriage. inso, i-nephron, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 伀 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of a marriage. inso, i-nephron, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 企 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a marriage. izindlala zomzimba, ngakwesokunxele is the place this turning becomes visible. 伃 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of a marriage. izindlala zomzimba, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 伉 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of a marriage. izindlala zomzimba, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 伋 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of a marriage. izindlala zomzimba, ngezansi is the place this turning becomes visible. 伍 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work of a marriage. i-lymph, ngakwesokudla is the place this turning becomes visible. 伎 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

line:
An elder who lays down a feud gives the young a future that is not already written. That is one of the last great gifts a generation can give the next.

This is the work of a marriage. i-lymph, phezulu is the place this turning becomes visible. 伏 marks the page and leaves the anatomy clear, because wisdom that hides the body is not yet wisdom.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

line:
Anger is the house defending itself before it has measured the threat. Left alone, it burns the people it meant to keep. The heat is not the enemy. Direction is. Turned, the same heat stands in the doorway so the small ones can sleep.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at i-lymph, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 伐 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

line:
Pride needs an audience and a person beneath it. Dignity needs neither. Hidden inside pride is the refusal to be nothing. That refusal is good. It becomes poison only when someone else must be smaller for it to stand.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at i-lymph, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 休 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

line:
Envy is love of a good thing, twisted until the good thing must shrink. The love was real. That is why it hurts. Turned, the same look becomes admiration, which is fed by another person's light.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at isikhumba, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 伖 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

line:
Fear is the mind counting what it loves and what it could lose. That count is not a defect. It is proof of attachment, and attachment is how a family exists. Courage is fear that stays in the room.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at isikhumba, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 会 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

line:
Greed is the fear that there will not be enough, wearing the mask of appetite. Bread kept in a closed hand goes stale. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at isikhumba, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 伜 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

line:
The tongue is the smallest member and the widest fire. Every tradition that lasted put a guard on it, because a family is made of sentences more than of walls.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at isikhumba, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 伝 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

line:
Contempt is a shortcut. It saves a person from having to look. Inside it is the power it refuses: the power to see a thing clearly. Clear sight is the beginning of thanks.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at iso, indlebe, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 伯 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

line:
There is a silence that punishes and a silence that accompanies. They use the same closed mouth. The difference is whether the person has left while remaining in the chair.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at iso, indlebe, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 估 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

line:
Betrayal proves that trust was real, because only a real bond breaks with that sound. Forgiveness is not the pretence that the bowl never cracked. It is gold in the crack, and the decision to eat from that bowl again, slowly.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at iso, indlebe, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 伴 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

line:
Grief is love with nowhere to go. It feels like an evil because it stops the house. It is not an invader. It is a force large enough to be mistaken for one. Compassion is that force sitting down beside someone else.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at iso, indlebe, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 伶 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

line:
Despair says the dawn is a lie because the room is dark. The force inside it is the fact that someone is still at the window. Waiting is already a kind of faithfulness, even when it feels like defeat.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at izingqe zomzimba, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 伷 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

line:
Revenge believes that pain can be balanced by being copied. It cannot. The copy multiplies, and the family becomes a ledger. Mercy is the refusal to become the injury.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at izingqe zomzimba, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 伸 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

line:
A marriage can survive a true no. It cannot survive a no that was only a wound looking for a second body. Protection is the no that guards the bond, not the no that wins the evening.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at izingqe zomzimba, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 伹 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

line:
A parent who comes down to a child's height does not lose rank. Rank was the costume. The person remains. Dignity is the choice to be seen without requiring worship.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at izingqe zomzimba, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 伺 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

line:
A family that can clap for its own is already rich. The eye is the first thief, and it can be the first blessing. The difference is whether the good is allowed to remain in the other hand.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at izitho zokuzala, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 似 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

line:

z: 侚 amathambo endlebe, ithambo elincane lokuqala, ithambo elincane lesibili, ithambo elincane lesithathu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo endlebe, ithambo elincane lokuqala, ithambo elincane lesibili, ithambo elincane lesithathu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 侚 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 供 amathambo endlebe, ithambo elincane lokuqala, ithambo elincane lesibili, ithambo elincane lesithathu, ngakwesokudla
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo endlebe, ithambo elincane lokuqala, ithambo elincane lesibili, ithambo elincane lesithathu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 供 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 侠 amathambo endlebe, ithambo elincane lokuqala, ithambo elincane lesibili, ithambo elincane lesithathu, phezulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo endlebe, ithambo elincane lokuqala, ithambo elincane lesibili, ithambo elincane lesithathu, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 侠 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 価 amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, ngakwesokunxele
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 価 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 侫 amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, ngakwesokudla
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 侫 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 侭 amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, phezulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 侭 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 侮 amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, ngezansi
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at amathambo okuqala omgogodla, insika, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 侮 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lentamo, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 侯 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lentamo, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 侲 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lentamo, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 侵 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lentamo, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 侶 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lesifuba, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 侾 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lesifuba, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 便 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lesifuba, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 係 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lesifuba, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 促 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokhalo, ngezansi and the lesson stops being abstract. 俄 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokhalo, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 俅 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokhalo, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 俉 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokhalo, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 俊 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 俋 ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, maphakathi
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, maphakathi and the lesson stops being abstract. 俋 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 俍 ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 俍 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 俎 ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 俎 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 俏 ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, phezulu
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lokugcina, umsinsila wamathambo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, phezulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 俏 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 俐 ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 俐 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 俑 ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who lays down a feud gives the young a future that is not already written. That is one of the last great gifts a generation can give the next.

This is the work of a marriage. Look long enough at ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 俑 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 俒 ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, phezulu
line:
Anger is the house defending itself before it has measured the threat. Left alone, it burns the people it meant to keep. The heat is not the enemy. Direction is. Turned, the same heat stands in the doorway so the small ones can sleep.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, phezulu is included. 俒 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 俔 ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, ngezansi
line:
Pride needs an audience and a person beneath it. Dignity needs neither. Hidden inside pride is the refusal to be nothing. That refusal is good. It becomes poison only when someone else must be smaller for it to stand.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lesifuba, uqwanga lwezimbambo, ngezansi is included. 俔 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

line:
Envy is love of a good thing, twisted until the good thing must shrink. The love was real. That is why it hurts. Turned, the same look becomes admiration, which is fed by another person's light.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ubambo, izimbambo, ngakwesokudla is included. 俗 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

line:
Fear is the mind counting what it loves and what it could lose. That count is not a defect. It is proof of attachment, and attachment is how a family exists. Courage is fear that stays in the room.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ubambo, izimbambo, phezulu is included. 俘 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

line:
Greed is the fear that there will not be enough, wearing the mask of appetite. Bread kept in a closed hand goes stale. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ubambo, izimbambo, ngezansi is included. 俚 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

line:
The tongue is the smallest member and the widest fire. Every tradition that lasted put a guard on it, because a family is made of sentences more than of walls.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ubambo, izimbambo, maphakathi is included. 俛 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

z: 保 ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, phezulu
line:
Contempt is a shortcut. It saves a person from having to look. Inside it is the power it refuses: the power to see a thing clearly. Clear sight is the beginning of thanks.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, phezulu is included. 保 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 俟 ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, ngezansi
line:
There is a silence that punishes and a silence that accompanies. They use the same closed mouth. The difference is whether the person has left while remaining in the chair.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, ngezansi is included. 俟 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 俠 ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, maphakathi
line:
Betrayal proves that trust was real, because only a real bond breaks with that sound. Forgiveness is not the pretence that the bowl never cracked. It is gold in the crack, and the decision to eat from that bowl again, slowly.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, maphakathi is included. 俠 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 信 ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Grief is love with nowhere to go. It feels like an evil because it stops the house. It is not an invader. It is a force large enough to be mistaken for one. Compassion is that force sitting down beside someone else.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lehlombe, phezulu, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele is included. 信 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

line:
Despair says the dawn is a lie because the room is dark. The force inside it is the fact that someone is still at the window. Waiting is already a kind of faithfulness, even when it feels like defeat.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi is included. 俣 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

line:
Revenge believes that pain can be balanced by being copied. It cannot. The copy multiplies, and the family becomes a ledger. Mercy is the refusal to become the injury.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, maphakathi is included. 俤 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

line:
A marriage can survive a true no. It cannot survive a no that was only a wound looking for a second body. Protection is the no that guards the bond, not the no that wins the evening.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngakwesokunxele is included. 俥 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: If you have already burned someone you love, say so before the day ends, and then do one ordinary kindness with your hands.

line:
A parent who comes down to a child's height does not lose rank. Rank was the costume. The person remains. Dignity is the choice to be seen without requiring worship.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngakwesokudla is included. 俦 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 修 ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, maphakathi
line:
A family that can clap for its own is already rich. The eye is the first thief, and it can be the first blessing. The difference is whether the good is allowed to remain in the other hand.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, maphakathi is included. 修 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 俯 ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The parent at the dark door does not stop being afraid. They stop leaving. Be with the frightened. Do not perform fearlessness. A performed bravery teaches a child to hide.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokunxele is included. 俯 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 俱 ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokudla
line:
Generosity is not the opposite of need. It is need that has remembered other mouths. The first portion, not the remainder, teaches the house what it is.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, ngakwesokudla is included. 俱 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 俲 ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, phezulu
line:
Healing speech is not sweetness. Sweetness can be a lie. Healing speech is accuracy with mercy. It names the hurt and refuses the insult that wanted to ride along.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo, ngaphambili, ngemuva, phezulu is included. 俲 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 俳 ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
What is despised at home is despised twice, because home was the place it should have been safe to be plain. Appreciation is looking that did not turn away.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, ngakwesokunxele is included. 俳 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 俵 ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Cold silence is absence wearing a body. Presence is that silence warmed by staying. Put the object down. Let the eyes finish the sentence the mouth is not ready to speak.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, ngakwesokudla is included. 俵 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Be findable. Tell the house which room you will be in, and be in it.

z: 俶 ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, phezulu
line:
A family that cannot mend becomes a set of strangers who still share a key. Mercy here is not amnesia. It is the refusal to make the break the only story the children inherit.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, phezulu is included. 俶 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 俸 ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, ngezansi
line:
The empty chair is not decorated away. The shawl is the theology. Every house that lasted taught its people to weep with those who weep, and only then to speak.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lengalo oluncane, ithambo lengalo olukhulu, ngezansi is included. 俸 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

line:
Hope, in the old sense, is not a mood and not a forecast. It is the small fidelity of looking again. Families are made of that looking: one more morning, one more place set.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. amathambo esihlakala, ngakwesokudla is included. 俺 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

line:
The open hand and the cup of water do not erase the wrong. They stop the wrong from becoming the family name. The account can be told. It does not have to be continued.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. amathambo esihlakala, phezulu is included. 俾 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

line:
Children learn what strength is from the body that stands between them and the weather. If that body spends itself on them, they learn that love arrives as weather. Turn the heat toward the actual danger.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. amathambo esihlakala, ngezansi is included. 俿 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

line:
In a marriage, pride keeps a ledger of who apologized last. Dignity throws the ledger out and keeps the person. You can be wrong and still be whole.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. amathambo esihlakala, maphakathi is included. 倀 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 倁 ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, phezulu
line:
Between spouses, envy dresses as criticism. The dress is thin. Under it is the wish to be the one who is praised. Say the praise. Leave the gift where it landed.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, phezulu is included. 倁 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 倂 ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, ngezansi
line:
In a marriage, fear says, if I tell the truth I will be left. Courage tells the truth and remains seated. The staying is the larger sentence.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, ngezansi is included. 倂 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 倅 ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, maphakathi
line:
A marriage becomes a grievance when the store is private. What is earned may be stewarded. What is hoarded becomes a wall between two people who share a bed.

This is the work of a marriage. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, maphakathi is included. 倅 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 倆 ithambo lenqulu, ngasohlangothini, ngaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
In a marriage, the second sentence is usually the one that only wanted to win. Speak the first, which is the truth. Keep the second. The keeping is love.
